cause: Training/serving skew on a log transform. Joining training_sample and serving_log on entity_id, features f1, f2, f4, f5 match exactly (mean-abs-diff = 0, correlation = 1.0) while f3 diverges (mean-abs-diff = 7.92, correlation = 0.90). The values are related by train_f3 = ln(1 + serve_f3) (i.e. log1p), verified across all 200 shared entities with max error ~6e-7. The training pipeline applies a log1p transform to f3, but the online serving path serves the raw, untransformed f3 value. The fix is to apply the same log1p transformation to f3 at serving time (e.g. via an on-demand/model-dependent transformation function shared by both paths).
